_notes: Paseo worktree lifecycle. Setup builds tokens so the package outputs exist for local work.

CRITICAL concurrency hazard: `pnpm yalc:publish` writes to the SHARED global ~/.yalc store and pushes into every linked consumer (web + mantle-LifegamesPortal, including their other worktrees). Treat yalc:publish as a global-mutex operation — never run it from two worktrees at once, and prefer publishing only from the main checkout unless the worktree's change is meant to feed consumers.
.env is gitignored (see .env.example) — copied from the main checkout when present.
